scenes.title: THE TRAP OPENS
scenes.narration: The farmer throws the pig into the well.

scenes.title: THEY RUSH IN
scenes.narration: Rats tumble down one by one, chasing easy food.

scenes.title: HUNTER AND HUNTED
scenes.narration: The survivor begins hunting its own kind.

scenes.title: WHO BENEFITS?
scenes.narration: A trap makes the crowd fight itself.

scenes.title: FIND THE EXIT
scenes.narration: Don't fight inside the trap. Find a way out.
